## %CAR+ traceability chain

**Bottom line:** The PPQ-001 %CAR+ results pass comfortably (36–45% against a ≥20% limit). The chain has real gaps, though. The MOI hard-stop requirement has no test evidence, the timing risk has no requirement or test behind it, and the EMS escalation test is stale after a change. The biggest open issue is an unexplained loss of %CAR+ on one vector lot, LV25-118, that follows a freezer excursion. The deviation on that excursion was closed with a donor-variability explanation that the data does not support.

### 1. Measurement and method validation
- **Quality attribute:** Transduction efficiency (release), test code FC-CAR, classed as a CQA. The unit is % of CD3+, and the release spec is ≥20%.
- **Method:** AM-FC-CAR (flow cytometry), VALIDATED over 5–90%. Its validation protocol is AMV-FC-CAR-01, with test case TC-AMV-CAR-01 (SCRIPTED, PASS 2026-03-20).
- **Derived link:** VCN-PER-CAR is calculated as VCN-DDPCR / (FC-CAR/100), so any error in %CAR+ also propagates into the VCN result.

### 2. Process parameters that drive it
| Parameter | Criticality | PPQ-001 limit | Evidence status |
|---|---|---|---|
| MOI (TU/cell) | CPP | 4.0–6.0 (crit 1) | Hard-stop requirement URS-EBR-009 has **no test evidence** (see gaps) |
| Time activation→transduction | CPP | 20–30 h (crit 5) | No URS or test traced to it; SOP-MFG-104 only |
| Vector storage temperature | KPP | none in PPQ-001 | Freezer URS only; no vector-specific requirement or PPQ criterion |

PPQ batches ran at MOI 5.0 and 21.9–23.7 h post-activation, so both CPPs were met.

### 3. Risks that threaten %CAR+ (RA-PFMEA-001 and the FRA set)
| Risk | Failure mode | RPN / class | Mitigation (graph) | Assessment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FM-06 | MOI below target (titer over-estimated, vector degradation) | 128 / HIGH | URS-EBR-007, SOP-MFG-104 | FRA-040 (HIGH) |
| FM-07 | Vector held above −70 °C (ULT freezer failure) | 96 / HIGH | URS-ULT-001, URS-ULT-002, URS-EMS-014, SOP-MAT-401 | FRA-008, FRA-009, FRA-027 |
| FM-08 | Transduction outside 20–30 h | 54 / MEDIUM | SOP-MFG-104 only | none |
| FM-15 | OOS result not flagged (also covers %CAR+) | 80 / HIGH | URS-LIMS-002, URS-LIMS-003 | FRA-031, FRA-032 |

FM-06 and FM-07 are the risks that actually explain the excursion pattern below.

### 4. Controls and test evidence, with gaps
- **URS-EBR-007** (vector volume from MOI, cell count and CoA titer): verified by TC-OQ-EBR-04, PASS 2026-03-17, on SYS-EBR. Current. The test challenged 2.5–10 TU/cell, not the 4–6 window.
- **URS-EBR-009** (MOI outside 4.0–6.0 rejected for GMP runs): HIGH risk (FRA-042), traced to CS-EBR-03, but **no test case verifies CS-EBR-03 or URS-EBR-009. This is an unverified HIGH-risk requirement.**
- **URS-ULT-001 and URS-ULT-002** (≤−70 °C and the −70 °C alarm, FRZ-80-01/02): verified by TC-OQ-ULT-01/02. Current for both units. FRZ-80-02 was re-verified on 2026-04-24, after CC-26-014 (compressor replacement, implemented 2026-04-23). The PQ run on FRZ-80-02 predates that change, but OQ meets the rule.
- **URS-EMS-014** (escalation of unacknowledged critical alarms within 15 min): verified only by TC-OQ-EMS-04 (PASS 2026-01-20). **Stale.** CC-26-011 modified its child spec CS-EMS-03 on 2026-03-16 and was closed as "no re-testing required." The definition requires re-execution or a documented regression assessment.
- **URS-LIMS-002/003** (second-person review, OOS flagging): verified by TC-OQ-LIMS-02/03 (Feb 2026). Current.
- **FM-08 (timing):** no requirement and no test. Control is a batch-record check only.
- **FM-07 vector storage:** no requirement, no PPQ criterion, and SOP-MAT-401 is not verified in the graph.
- **FM-06:** the CoA titer is the only detection, and it is taken at receipt. The graph has no control that detects loss of potency after storage.

### 5. How it performed in PPQ
PPQ-001 (status: execution complete, report pending) covers PPQ26-01 to PPQ26-05:

| Batch | Vector lot | %CAR+ | VCN/CAR+ | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PPQ26-01 | LV26-007 | 44.6 | 2.39 | PASS |
| PPQ26-02 | LV26-007 | 39.2 | 2.23 | PASS |
| PPQ26-03 | LV26-007 | 36.1 | 1.79 | PASS |
| PPQ26-04 | LV26-021 | 38.9 | 1.87 | PASS |
| PPQ26-05 | LV26-021 | 37.3 | 2.22 | PASS |

The mean is about 39%. All batches met the MOI and timing CPPs and the VCN limit.

Two other GMP runs used the same process version and are not PPQ batches. ENG26-01, -02 and -03 gave 19.8, 11.9 and 13.9%, below the 20% informational floor. They used vector lot LV25-118.

### 6. Deviations and how they connect
- **DEV-26-021 (MAJOR, CLOSED):** FRZ-80-02 compressor failure from 2026-04-20. The alarm started at 03:20 and was acknowledged at 14:40 (11 h 20 min). The deviation says the vector and cytokine lots were moved to FRZ-80-01 at 15:30, with a max of about −36 °C before relocation. It was assessed as "short, low risk, no hold." Other points from the data:
  - The historian for FRZ-80-02 shows the chamber stayed above −25 °C until about 11:00 on 2026-04-23, reaching −10 °C, so the "short excursion" label understates the event.
  - The material table still lists LV25-118 in FRZ-80-02, so the relocation is not confirmed in the data.
  - CAPA-26-008 (compressor replacement) is closed and effective. It does not address the lot.
- **The LV25-118 pattern:** Before the excursion, batches on LV25-118 gave 35–41% (PD26-020 to -023). After it, PD26-024 to -027 gave 15–17%, and ENG26-01 to -03 gave 12–20%. The same donor (HD-0118) gave 41.3% on LV25-118 before the excursion and 16.0% after, and 44.6% on LV26-007. The donor is therefore not the explanation. The pattern is consistent with loss of functional titer (FM-06/FM-07), which the CoA (104 M TU/mL, released) does not show. This is an inference, not a confirmed root cause.
- **DEV-26-027 (ATYPICAL_RESULT, OPEN):** attributed to donor variability (CAPA-26-016, which covers a CD3 minimum). That root cause is not supported by the starting-material CD3 data. The PD runs on this lot have no deviations, by design, so the drop was never investigated.
- **DEV-26-033 (PROTOCOL_DEVIATION, PPQ26-02, CLOSED):** harvest viability below PPQ-001 criterion 6, linked to the INC-03 door (CAPA-26-012, still open and past its 2026-03-31 due date; CC-26-019 approved but not implemented). Not a %CAR+ driver, but relevant to PPQ readiness.
- **DEV-26-011, DEV-26-038, DEV-26-041:** not related to %CAR+.

### 7. Open change control
- **CC-26-022 (APPROVED? no: IMPACT ASSESSMENT):** proposes raising target MOI from 5.0 to 8.0 TU/cell to improve %CAR+. This conflicts with URS-EBR-009, CS-EBR-03 (hard stop 4–6) and PPQ-001 criterion 1. It also needs SOP-MFG-104 and the pFMEA revised. The DoE data shows MOI 10 gives 65–68% with VCN/CAR+ of about 3.0–3.3, and MOI 15 gives 76–77% with VCN/CAR+ of 4.7–4.8, close to the 5.0 limit. There is no DoE data at MOI 8.

### Priority gaps
1. URS-EBR-009 (HIGH, MOI hard stop) has no test evidence.
2. URS-EMS-014 is stale after CC-26-011 and was not re-tested.
3. FM-08 (timing) has no requirement or test.
4. FM-06/FM-07: no post-storage potency check. LV25-118 lot exposure is unresolved, and DEV-26-021 and DEV-26-027 do not connect it.
5. CC-26-022 conflicts with the MOI control and lacks a verification plan.

content.text:
## %CAR+ traceability chain

**Bottom line:** The PPQ-001 %CAR+ results pass comfortably (36–45% against a ≥20% limit). The chain has real gaps, though. The MOI hard-stop requirement has no test evidence, the timing risk has no requirement or test behind it, and the EMS escalation test is stale after a change. The biggest open issue is an unexplained loss of %CAR+ on one vector lot, LV25-118, that follows a freezer excursion. The deviation on that excursion was closed with a donor-variability explanation that the data does not support.

### 1. Measurement and method validation
- **Quality attribute:** Transduction efficiency (release), test code FC-CAR, classed as a CQA. The unit is % of CD3+, and the release spec is ≥20%.
- **Method:** AM-FC-CAR (flow cytometry), VALIDATED over 5–90%. Its validation protocol is AMV-FC-CAR-01, with test case TC-AMV-CAR-01 (SCRIPTED, PASS 2026-03-20).
- **Derived link:** VCN-PER-CAR is calculated as VCN-DDPCR / (FC-CAR/100), so any error in %CAR+ also propagates into the VCN result.

### 2. Process parameters that drive it
| Parameter | Criticality | PPQ-001 limit | Evidence status |
|---|---|---|---|
| MOI (TU/cell) | CPP | 4.0–6.0 (crit 1) | Hard-stop requirement URS-EBR-009 has **no test evidence** (see gaps) |
| Time activation→transduction | CPP | 20–30 h (crit 5) | No URS or test traced to it; SOP-MFG-104 only |
| Vector storage temperature | KPP | none in PPQ-001 | Freezer URS only; no vector-specific requirement or PPQ criterion |

PPQ batches ran at MOI 5.0 and 21.9–23.7 h post-activation, so both CPPs were met.

### 3. Risks that threaten %CAR+ (RA-PFMEA-001 and the FRA set)
| Risk | Failure mode | RPN / class | Mitigation (graph) | Assessment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FM-06 | MOI below target (titer over-estimated, vector degradation) | 128 / HIGH | URS-EBR-007, SOP-MFG-104 | FRA-040 (HIGH) |
| FM-07 | Vector held above −70 °C (ULT freezer failure) | 96 / HIGH | URS-ULT-001, URS-ULT-002, URS-EMS-014, SOP-MAT-401 | FRA-008, FRA-009, FRA-027 |
| FM-08 | Transduction outside 20–30 h | 54 / MEDIUM | SOP-MFG-104 only | none |
| FM-15 | OOS result not flagged (also covers %CAR+) | 80 / HIGH | URS-LIMS-002, URS-LIMS-003 | FRA-031, FRA-032 |

FM-06 and FM-07 are the risks that actually explain the excursion pattern below.

### 4. Controls and test evidence, with gaps
- **URS-EBR-007** (vector volume from MOI, cell count and CoA titer): verified by TC-OQ-EBR-04, PASS 2026-03-17, on SYS-EBR. Current. The test challenged 2.5–10 TU/cell, not the 4–6 window.
- **URS-EBR-009** (MOI outside 4.0–6.0 rejected for GMP runs): HIGH risk (FRA-042), traced to CS-EBR-03, but **no test case verifies CS-EBR-03 or URS-EBR-009. This is an unverified HIGH-risk requirement.**
- **URS-ULT-001 and URS-ULT-002** (≤−70 °C and the −70 °C alarm, FRZ-80-01/02): verified by TC-OQ-ULT-01/02. Current for both units. FRZ-80-02 was re-verified on 2026-04-24, after CC-26-014 (compressor replacement, implemented 2026-04-23). The PQ run on FRZ-80-02 predates that change, but OQ meets the rule.
- **URS-EMS-014** (escalation of unacknowledged critical alarms within 15 min): verified only by TC-OQ-EMS-04 (PASS 2026-01-20). **Stale.** CC-26-011 modified its child spec CS-EMS-03 on 2026-03-16 and was closed as "no re-testing required." The definition requires re-execution or a documented regression assessment.
- **URS-LIMS-002/003** (second-person review, OOS flagging): verified by TC-OQ-LIMS-02/03 (Feb 2026). Current.
- **FM-08 (timing):** no requirement and no test. Control is a batch-record check only.
- **FM-07 vector storage:** no requirement, no PPQ criterion, and SOP-MAT-401 is not verified in the graph.
- **FM-06:** the CoA titer is the only detection, and it is taken at receipt. The graph has no control that detects loss of potency after storage.

### 5. How it performed in PPQ
PPQ-001 (status: execution complete, report pending) covers PPQ26-01 to PPQ26-05:

| Batch | Vector lot | %CAR+ | VCN/CAR+ | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
